description: List the questions asked of a Foundry ontology, or of one thread, newest first and without their answers, with the workspace's question budget.

page_token.description: Opaque continuation token from the previous call.

thread_id.description: Only this thread's questions; every question when empty.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_list_questions

result.description: Untrusted answer: the ontology agent's AskResult, set once answered or cannot_answer. An integer past 2^53 comes as a string of its digits, which JSON numbers would round. Its queries come without their outputs: to see the rows one of the answer's visuals shows, read its query (queries[].query) again with helix_foundry_read_graph, as a query read on the question's load_id.

title: List Foundry questions
